articles.summary: West Africa’s pioneer solar-based internet service provider, Tizeti, has won the Internet Service Provider (ISP) of the Year award at the Beacon of ICT Awards (BoICT), organised by the Nigerian Communications Week over the weekend. After a competitive review process, Tizeti was selected for the award due to its innovative model of addressing the digital divide with solar-powered masts to […]
articles.title: Tizeti wins ISP of the year award
